title: binance-listing-study: Death-Inclusive Event Dataset for Every Binance Spot USDT Listing, 2021-2026

creators.name: Bakhtiev, Said
creators.affiliation: Gymnasium of Aznakayevo, Republic of Tatarstan, Russia

description: Companion repository for the preprint Post-Listing Underperformance in Cryptocurrency Markets: Evidence from Every Binance USDT Listing, 2021-2026. The release contains the point-in-time listing calendars rebuilt from the raw data.binance.vision archive (3,682 archived symbols; 470 Binance spot USDT events retained, delisted tokens included; 829 Bybit USDT listings), the enriched 470×28 event panel used for all reported estimates, the day-0 USD turnover extract, the event-study and holdout code with the raw kline caches required for replication, and a claim-by-claim falsification matrix for the prior listing literature.
